name: med-research-assistant
description: Federated medical literature search and evidence-verification tools using free scholarly APIs and authorized browser fallbacks.

interface.shortDescription: Search and verify medical literature without paid API keys.
interface.longDescription: Federated retrieval from free scholarly services, open-access resolution, clinical-trial search, Chinese-portal handoff, deduplication, and an auditable medical-evidence workflow.
defaultPrompt: Search current medical evidence for this clinical research question.
Build a PICO search strategy and verify every citation.
Find open full text for these DOI or PMID identifiers.
